items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: He would starve for a friendship thing... He would come down to the boat, meet me

ctx.x: He was, he was, he was plunging. He was kind of slow. I loved the slowest he called it. Of course, he was there with his high notes. And of course, here's another one. Punching Chris Kelly. You remember when they met? Sure, he used to stop on the corner of my house on the lobby. I used to stop in place for him because the first appearance was just a couple blocks away. The floor was on me, it was just a block of two. So they may be playing at either one of the halls. And of course, Buddy would come from across…
I wish you had remembered some of his song. I sure wish I could.
